config.question: Do the LDA/Mahalanobis readout and the class-balanced ridge beat the sealed anchor 0.24214492753623187 with no feature change, at the train-side lambda M297 chose?

registered_readout_definitions.balanced_ridge: weighted least squares, per-row weight 1/n_{y_i} (each class contributes total weight 1), symmetric Gram + lambda* I, no prior term
registered_readout_definitions.lda: scores x^T A^-1 m_c - 1/2 m_c^T A^-1 m_c + log(n_c/n), A = symmetric standardised Gram + lambda* I, m_c the class means

config.registered_transfer_rule: lambda* is the M297 LOOCV choice, train-side only; it transfers to the LDA and balanced-ridge readouts as a registered constant. If M297 is not sealed, the cell is VOID (the fallback lambda is recorded but never feeds a solve when the dependency gate fails).
